content.text:
Added right-click support for workspace tabs in `apps/app/src/components/topbar.tsx` using the shared `ContextMenu` component.

What it does:
- Right-click any workspace tab to open a menu
- Menu includes:
  - `Open`
  - `Remove`

Implementation notes:
- Reused `@agentide/ui` context-menu primitives
- Wired `Remove` to the existing `onRemoveWorkspace` callback
- Kept left-click behavior unchanged

Validation:
- Ran lint/type checks on the changed files
- No errors or warnings

If you want, I can also add:
- `Rename`
- `Duplicate`
- `Close others`
- `Close to the right`
